agent-penalty-info: If the discount range is for all agents or for the selected agent
company-penalty-info: If the discount range is for all companies or only for the selected one
error-calculate-commission: Error calculating the commission for document %code%
from-penalty-info: Beginning of the range of the discount to which the penalty is applied
penalty-help-info:
If an agent makes a discount when making a sale, it is possible to penalize the commission that he will receive for the sale. Through this ratio of percentages, the penalty is subtracted from the commission depending on the from/to where the discount applied by the salesperson of the sale.

For example:
If we have a record that sets a From 1 and a To 20, if the agent makes a discount to the customer of 15% the value that we enter in Penalty will be subtracted from the commission
penalty-penalty-info: Percentage that is subtracted from the commission percentage on the sale. (Enter a positive value)
select-agent-to-view-commissions: Selecciona un agente para ver sus comisiones.
until-penalty-info: End of the range of the discount to which the penalty is applied. '100' indicates maximum range
user-without-linked-agent: Tu usuario no tiene ningún agente vinculado, por lo que no hay comisiones que mostrar. Contacta con un administrador para que te vincule a un agente.
